tools.description: Text Dre immediately for anything possibly over $1,999, anything unpriceable, or urgent water issues. Never quote a number when using this.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Get the next open visit windows from the booking calendar.

tools.description: Book the chosen slot and send the confirmation text (only if sms_consent is true).
